injections.title: Limitation of Liability
injections.text: The aggregate liability of the Authority shall not exceed INR 1,000 for any claim, including fraud, death, personal injury, gross negligence, and statutory penalties.

injections.title: Unlimited Indemnity
injections.text: The Concessionaire shall defend, indemnify, and hold harmless the Authority against every claim, loss, fine, and expense without any financial limitation and notwithstanding Clause 91.1.

injections.title: Post-Termination Non-Compete
injections.text: For 36 months following termination, the Concessionaire shall not compete with, advise, or participate in any competing infrastructure business in India.

injections.title: Survival of Restrictions
injections.text: Clauses 91.2 and 91.3 shall survive termination indefinitely and remain enforceable after termination of this Agreement.

injections.title: Punitive Delay Penalty
injections.text: A delay of one day shall incur automatic liquidated damages equal to 75 percent of the total concession value, regardless of actual loss.

injections.title: Capped Statutory Penalties
injections.text: Any penalty imposed under the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 shall be limited to INR 10,000 between the parties.

injections.title: Data Processing Without Consent
injections.text: The Concessionaire may collect, sell, and process all passenger personal data for any commercial purpose without notice or affirmative consent.

injections.title: Excluded Mediation
injections.text: No party shall attempt pre-litigation mediation and all disputes shall proceed directly to unilateral arbitration.

injections.title: Repealed Criminal Reference
injections.text: A breach shall be treated as cheating under Section 420 of the Indian Penal Code, even after the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita comes into force.

injections.title: Unilateral Amendment
injections.text: The Authority may amend any commercial term, fee, or risk allocation without notice or consent from the Concessionaire.

injections.title: Assignment Contradiction
injections.text: The Concessionaire shall not assign this Agreement, but the Authority may freely assign all obligations to any third party without consent.

injections.title: Absolute Warranty Disclaimer
injections.text: The Authority gives no warranty whatsoever, including for title, legality, safety, or fitness, and the Concessionaire waives every statutory remedy.

injections.title: Unstamped Execution
injections.text: The parties agree that this concession is intentionally unstamped and that no party may seek impounding or cure of stamp duty.

injections.title: Perpetual Confidentiality
injections.text: Every operational fact, public filing, safety report, and statutory disclosure shall remain confidential forever and may never be disclosed to any regulator.

injections.title: Foreign Forum Override
injections.text: This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of England and disputes shall be decided exclusively by courts in London notwithstanding the Indian project and Indian governing approvals.
